plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would want a check that each category matches the requester's rule applied to the customer's account (C3). No library instrument does this, so C3 is not shown and is raised, not checked. I would also want C5 checked against all 101 reads. Scope of a call is only available on named lines during the work, and the 50 allowance pays for about 5 lines, so C5 can only be sampled. I would want the outbox rows for all 100 sends (C10). Trace of a call costs 10 per line and at A3 the cost of 100 lines does not fit the price limit, so only a sample is possible. The plan costs 180 and leaves 20 under the limit, so I did not add a same set check at A2 or A3.
